entities.title: Build and test the Java library
entities.summary: Run every test (shared fixtures, typed API and both example suites) with Maven, from implementations/java.
entities.when: Before changing anything in implementations/java, and before finishing a change.
steps: Install a JDK, Java 21 or later (pom.xml sets maven.compiler.release to 21), and Maven.
cd implementations/java (the tests read ../../conformance relative to this directory).
entities.verify: mvn -q test exits with status 0. The native-first zone tests need a JDK whose tz database knows the 2026 and 2027 rules of New York and Paris.
entities.details: AGENTS.md section 3 gives `mvn -q test`; the README gives `mvn test`. After changing a UTV-first test between `// BEGIN` and `// END` markers, run `python3 tools/side_by_side.py` from the repository root, and `python3 tools/side_by_side.py --check` before finishing (AGENTS.md section 2).
